Our school

Ten years of “Everybody can learn & succeed.”

The story, the mission and the people behind Excellence International Schools, Jalingo.

Our story

A school that opened its gates on 19 September 2016

Excellence International Schools opened in Jalingo, Taraba State, on 19 September 2016 — a Saturday school-room with a conviction too large for its size: everybody can learn and succeed.

Ten years on, that conviction still runs the school. We balance the British and Nigerian curricula across Key Stages 1–4 — from Nursery & Early Years to Senior Secondary — with strong safeguarding, disciplined habits and a warm, structured daily life.

This overview brings together the school’s academic, pastoral and community priorities.

Mission & vision

What we promise, in our own words

Our mission

“Everybody can learn and succeed. Our shared purpose is that every child who walks through our gates learns to succeed — academically, morally and socially.”

Our vision

“To create a Key Stages 1–4 school that balances the British and Nigerian curricula — a school every parent in Taraba is proud to send their child to, and where every child reaches God-given potential.”

Pastoral & character

Policies you’ll find in the school handbook: clear discipline, sound welfare, respect for every child, and a house system that lets pupils grow as leaders.

A balanced curriculum

Two strong traditions in one timetable — the British curriculum’s Key Stage structure and the Nigerian curriculum that readers, parents and WAEC/NECO pace expect. More on learning.

Milestones

Growth, labelled honestly

A brief history of the school’s growth, from its first classrooms to the community it is today.

19 Sept 2016

Excellence International Schools opens its gates

The founding on a Jalingo school morning — nursery, primary and the promise “everybody can learn and succeed.” (Verified from the school’s own history.)

2019 (approx. year)

Full key stages take shape

Nursery through Senior Secondary now learn within one school community, supported by specialist teaching, practical science and structured exam preparation.

19 Sept 2026

The 10th anniversary

A decade of EIS — reunion week, prizegiving and a celebration open to every family who has ever walked the mile-6 gates. (Anniversary date is real.)

School leadership

The people in charge of every detail

Our leadership team sets the academic, pastoral and operational direction of EIS.

Lead — experienced principal educator

Provides academic leadership across the school and supports teachers to deliver a consistent, ambitious education.

Head of Admissions

Guides families from their first enquiry through visits, applications and admission.

Head of Science

Leads practical science across the three laboratories and develops opportunities for pupils to investigate, test and present their ideas.

Head of Pastoral & Boarding

Coordinates pastoral care, boarding routines and safeguarding so every pupil is known, supported and safe.
